youtube.title: What if you sailed with the biggest invasion fleet in history?
youtube.description:
1281: 4,400 ships, 140,000 men – and a typhoon nobody saw coming. 🌊⚓ Divers just found dice in one of the wrecks off Takashima.
The typhoon hits. Where are you? A) Below deck B) Holding the mast C) Cutting the chains – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Fukuoka Now & Archaeology Magazine (third Takashima wreck, Oct/Nov 2026), World History Encyclopedia (Mongol invasions of Japan)
